title: Chiyu Mahou no Machigatta Tsukaikata
jp_title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
description: An ordinary walk home from school turns into an epic journey for Usato. After suddenly being dropped into another world with two fellow students, Usato learns he was summoned there by accident. But things turn around when he discovers a unique aptitude for healing magic! Now, he trains beyond human limitations, using his self-healing abilities to gain absurd strength and unrivaled stamina. (Source: Crunchyroll)
